thesis: The page is the year over central Oklahoma: each section is a season band that shows what that weather does to a roof and what Hailward does about it, and the signature is the month ring that turns as you scroll through the almanac.

signature.name: Month Ring Almanac
signature.summary: Circular 12-segment month ring in top-right (desktop) or sticky pill (mobile); advances to highlight the current season band on scroll. Reused in hero, five season bands, reviews (month earned), and footer reset. Hook: data-sw-signature='month-ring'.

palette.family: Storm Slate + Hail White + Prairie Gold

motion.intro: Storm-cell shadow drifts SW→NE across metro map; town names light up; 1.0s, skippable.
stories: Month ring rotates one notch per season band (verb: dial)
Season photos unclip via clip-path inset wipe (verb: wipe)
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms
